svg.title: Reading a piecewise graph
svg.desc: Graph of a piecewise function f on the domain from x = -4 to x = 5. On the left, a parabola piece starts at the filled point (-4, 1), dips to its lowest point (-2, -1) and rises toward an open circle at (1, 3.5). On the right, a straight line starts at the filled point (1, 5) and falls to the filled point (5, 1). So f(1) = 5, the range is from -1 to 5, and the horizontal line y = 2 meets the graph at x = 0 and x = 4.

text.tspan: (1, 3.5), but that point is not on the graph.
